records.label: Caris Assure blood report and file accession cross-check
records.verification: Original case identifiers in the supplied file metadata match the Caris Assure report for peripheral blood collected 27 January 2026, reported 6 February 2026. This is separate from the March 2024 rectal biopsy. The report defines gDNA as buffy-coat DNA. RNA and cfTNA fraction assignments remain qualified; exact tube/aliquot links are not confirmed.

records.label: Caris file-fraction clarification recorded 19 October 2026
records.verification: Provider clarification supplied to this record on 19 October 2026: gDNA/GDNA denotes buffy-coat/germline material; cfTNA/CFTNA denotes cell-free total nucleic acid. Both filename families include DNA/exome and RNA/transcriptome files. The provider also reports that the cell-free DNA R2 FASTQ is available in its delivery. This is a provenance statement; receipt, file integrity, mate pairing and clinical germline interpretation are separate questions. Exact tube, extraction, library and reference FASTA/checksum links are not supplied by this clarification.

records.label: Caris additional delivery checked 19 October 2026
records.verification: The provider delivery was checked on 19 October 2026. The received cell-free RNA expression CSV contains 59,960 unique gene rows with Gene, TPM and NumReads columns. Every row parsed, numeric values are finite and nonnegative, and complete source and prepared SHA-256 values match. All source bytes are preserved under a neutral public filename. The announced checksum manifests, specimen workbooks, copy-number tables, fusion files, capture intervals, tissue expression table and additional report copies were not visible or retrievable through the current Caris connection on 19 October 2026. This check does not establish whether the files were absent or access-restricted. Local SHA-256 verification does not substitute for the missing vendor checksum manifests. The additional cell-free DNA/RNA reads and alignments and cell-free DNA variant calls subsequently passed scientific-content preservation checks and full authenticated and anonymous download verification; final bytes and SHA-256 values are recorded in the release catalogues.

records.label: StoreMyTumor primary tissue processing report
records.verification: One original report page visually reviewed. Documents collected material and cryopreserved-fragment inventory. Collection date is printed as 10/6/2026; its interpretation as 6 October 2026 was separately confirmed by me on 20 October 2026 (M-SOURCE-017). Site linkage comes from the patient; no pathology or post-thaw QC is supplied.

records.label: Patient clarification of nodal-biopsy collection date
records.verification: On 20 October 2026 I confirmed that the collection date printed as 10/6/2026 in the StoreMyTumor processing report means 6 October 2026. This clarification resolves the numeric date order; it is not an additional provider report or confirmation of pathology, anatomical site or assay suitability.

B7 is mapped to the rectal resection collected 22 October 2024; exact _43 section linkage is unresolved. Automated drug annotations are source content, not validated eligibility.

records.label: Independent B7_43 quantitative reanalysis and therapeutic review
records.verification: Conservative gene mapping, peptide-sequence uniqueness audit, composition-sensitive within-sample signal ranks and separate public cohort context. AO-control provenance audited; unidentified control excluded from tumour-versus-normal conclusions. No raw-spectra re-search or validated patient iBAQ.
